name: Transit
tagline: Every step a station; you always know where the train is.
mood: Standing on a quiet platform at night, reading the line map: you know exactly where the train is and how many stops remain.
rationale: A metro line map is the most glanced-at diagram in the world: one colored line, filled and empty circles, a "you are here" marker, and nothing else. That is exactly what a tool you look at a hundred times a day needs. It answers the spacing complaint by giving every row the same skeleton (rail at col 2, station glyph at col 4, name at col 6, right column flush at col 72) and by separating sections with the only separator a map uses: whitespace. The meter becomes a strip of the line with the train on it, the plan becomes the line with its stations, and the glyph set is read without learning. One deliberate tradeoff: done is carried by shape (a filled station in the line's color), not by green, so the only green in PLAN is a done phase's count and the gate; a glance tells you where the train is first and what passed second.
tokenMap: bg: the terminal's own background (no key, nothing is painted). fg: `text`. dim: `inactive` via dimColor (section labels, done station names, the rail ahead of the train, right-column metadata). success/warning/error: the theme keys `success`/`warning`/`error`, meaning unchanged: ✓ gate, finished health and a done phase's count, `?`/`~` and `? D1`, `!`/`✗` and blocked stations. accent and accent2 are hex, so the mod picks the scheme itself: at activation it reads `(await $.config.list()).find(r => r.key === 'theme')`, keeps the value in a state atom and refreshes it from `on('config.set', { key: 'theme' })`; a value starting with `light` (light, light-ansi, light-daltonized) selects lightPalette, anything else the dark palette. accent: the current line's color, #5fa8e6 dark / #1f6fb5 light (line B in the mock: badge, rail up to the train, filled stations, the train ◉, the active tab, the step id in the band). accent2: line A's color, #b58ad8 / #7a4ea8 (its chip and its cells in the pane-header strip). Lines take their color by phase index from [line A, line B, `claude`], so phase C gets the engine's `claude` key (orange/terracotta, theme-aware) once it opens; a todo line is drawn dim until then. bg2: the "you are here" row, Box backgroundColor #1b2129 / #e9edf2 chosen by the same switch. If the theme row is ever missing, the lines fall back to theme keys (A `planMode`, B `merged`, C `claude`), no bg2 is painted, and the train glyph is drawn Text inverse in the line color so it still separates from a done station. inverse: the line badge ` B ` (Text inverse with color=accent: accent background, bg-colored letter).

otherTabs: Plan: every line stacked, each a badge row (` A ` violet, ` B ` blue, ` C ` dim) that is the fold Button, with `5/5` at the right (in success once the line is done); a folded line shows only its badge and title, an open one draws its rail of stations exactly as the overview does, so the whole tab reads as the network map. Log: a departures board, hh:mm dim in a 6-wide column at col 2 and the text at col 8, Rulings in warning; newest first. Step details: the station sign on top (badge, station glyph, bold name), `b: ← Overview  k: Prev  j: Next` reading as previous/next station, then the 8-wide dim field labels (status, note, commit, gate, agents, drift, asks) with values at col 10, and its log lines below a blank line. Needs you: one card per question with the `?` in warning, the station it holds (`blocks B4 Upgrade prompt copy`) and the asked time as a dim meta line, `why` as a field, the options as Buttons with the recommended one `variant="primary"`, the text field beneath; drift and answered items follow under their own dim labels after one blank line.
glyphs: todo `○` dim (station not yet served) · doing `◉` bold in the line color (the train) on the bg2 row · done `●` in the line color (filled station) · blocked `!` error (station closed) · skipped `–` dim (train does not stop) · current phase: the inverse badge ` B ` in the pane and `◉B` in the chip strip, done phase `●A` in its line color, todo phase `○C` dim · decision `?` warning · blocker `!` error · drift `~` warning · health unchanged: `▶` working / `!` needs you (error) / `✗` gate red (error) / `✓` finished (success) · rail: `├` on every station row, `└` on whatever row the phase draws last; line color up to and including the train, dim after it · fold rows when the overview's window does not fit the phase: `├ ● 3 done above` (rail and station in the line color, text dim) above the window and `└ ○ +2 more` (all dim) below it, so the rail stays continuous · band meter (10 cells, coarse by design): the train sits at index floor(done·(cells−1)/total), `━` before it in the line color, `─` after it dim, so 0/18 is `◉─────────`, 7/18 is `━━━◉──────`, 16/18 and 17/18 are `━━━━━━━━◉─`, and the terminus `━━━━━━━━━◉` is reached only at 18/18, drawn in success · pane header strip (exact, one cell per step while total ≤ 24, else the band rule on 20 cells): done `━` in its phase's line color, the current step `◉` in its line color, the rest `─` dim (18 here: `━━━━━━━◉──────────`); finished: every cell `━` in its line color and the last one `◉` in success (`━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━◉`) · finished band: `✓ 18/18 ━━━━━━━━━◉  · gate ✓ 4m · 9e1d0aa 2m · took 3h12m`, health and train in success, no step, no counts at the right · finished pane header: `✓ Add team billing` with `took 3h12m` at the right and the finished strip beside `18/18` · empty worklog (0 steps): the band shows `▶ 0/0` and the elapsed time with no meter; the pane header shows `0/0` and no strip, and the plan draws `○ no stations yet` dim under the badge row, no rail, no train · gate ✓/✗ keep success/error.
spacingRules: The mock is the 72-cell inner width; the Box's paddingX={1} adds the outer gutter. Column skeleton: col 1 blank, col 2 the glyph/rail column (health `!`, `?`, `~`, section labels, `├`/`└`), col 4 the station glyph or the text of a needs row and the title, col 6 the step name; the one deliberate exception is the line badge ` B ` spanning cols 1–3, centered on the rail column so the line visibly hangs from it, with its title at col 6 like the stations. Right column: right-aligned flush at col 72, at most 12 cells (`opus 6m Edit`; sha 7, `sonnet 1m` 9, times ≤ 5), and the left text is clipped so at least 2 cells separate them. Sections: exactly one blank line above each dim bold label, labels at col 2, no rules (the same on mono and proportional surfaces). SIGNALS: labels 4 wide padded to 6 (`gate  `, `git   `, `ctx   `) so values start at col 8; the second column (`git`) starts at col 36; below 62 columns git wraps to its own row under gate with the same label width. Pane header: the strip has priority over the branch text, which truncates with `…` as today once `branch · gate` plus the strip and the count no longer fit. Footer: buttons separated by 3 spaces (Box gap 3), each label as the engine renders it with its hotkey prefix. Never adjacent: a glyph and its text (always one space), the right column and a title (≥ 2), two sections (always a blank line), the bg2 train row and a section label (a station row always sits above and below it, or the badge row above).
desktopNotes: Desktop app, VS Code and mobile draw in a proportional font, so the `├`/`└` column cannot be relied on to line up: the rail is dropped there and each station row is glyph + name (`● B1 Hide billing tab`), the right column held by `<Box flexGrow={1}/>` (layout, which does hold), and the badge drawn with Text inverse, which works anywhere. The strip in the pane header becomes an Svg: 18 small circles on a line, filled in their line colors, the train a larger ring; static by default, `isInteractive` with a slow CSS opacity pulse on the train while an agent runs (desktop only). SIGNALS use Box gap instead of the fixed col 36. bg2 on the train row works through Box backgroundColor, with the same theme-row switch. Section labels are the same dim bold text with marginTop 1 as today. Mobile is identical minus animation and minus the band (there is none); the Needs-you tab keeps its option Buttons and "Reply in chat". VS Code has no band; the pane is as on desktop.

animation.idea: The train breathes at its station while an agent works, and departs for the next station when a step is marked done.
animation.trigger: A step marked done: departure pulse, 4 frames over 1 s, the departed station goes ◉ ◎ ● ● while the train is drawn at the next cell. A gate passing: the travelled cells flash the success hex once (2 frames, 250 ms) and settle back to their line hexes. A question raised: nothing moves; `? 1` simply appears, so attention is drawn by stillness. At rest: while an agent is running the train alternates ◉/◎ every 2 s; while the person is typing one frame every 6 s; after 5 min idle, when finished or paused, and on mobile/VS Code: the static frame. The Raster has no theme keys or dimColor, so it carries its own per-scheme hex set (dark/light): line A #b58ad8/#7a4ea8, line B #5fa8e6/#1f6fb5, line C #da7756/#b8542f, rail ahead #717d8a/#6e7883, success flash #5fbf85/#1f8a4c; every cell background is 0x01000000 (the terminal's default).
animation.cadence: 4 fps for 1 s on events; 0.5 fps at rest while agents run; about 0.17 fps while the person types; 0 otherwise
animation.staticFrame: ━━━━━━━◉──────────  7/18 (the pane-header strip exactly as drawn in Text, which is also the frame whenever the Raster is not mounted; the band never animates and is plain Text)

feasibility: Everything is Box/Text/Button and every glyph (├ └ ● ◉ ◎ ○ ━ ─ ✓ ? ! ~ –) is width-1 BMP. (a) The step id colored inside the band's step Button and the stations' Buttons needs a Text chip inside the label, which the brief allows; fallback is a plain label with the id uncolored. (b) The footer is drawn as the engine renders hotkey Buttons (`1: Overview   2: Plan …`, 69 cells); the active tab is accent bold instead of brackets. (c) Raster is terminal-only and its cells are `[codePoint, 0x00RRGGBB, bg]` with no theme keys, so the animated strip uses the hex set in the animation notes with 0x01000000 backgrounds; it is an Svg on desktop and static Text on mobile/VS Code, and the Text strip is the frame whenever the Raster is not mounted. (d) accent, accent2 and bg2 are hex and cannot follow the theme by themselves, so the scheme is read from the `theme` config row (`$.config.list()`), refreshed on `config.set`; only if the row is missing do the lines fall back to theme keys, bg2 is skipped and the train is drawn inverse. (e) The `├` rail only aligns in a monospace grid, so it is dropped on proportional surfaces (see desktopNotes); single-side Box borders are not assumed since borders take a full row and column. (f) band60 follows the code's drop order unchanged (bar drops before gate), so the strip is lost below about 70 columns; the step id in the line color carries the identity there. (g) `blocks B4` on the decision row and `? D1`/`sonnet 1m` on todo rows are derived from the sample data but need the small stepRow/needs changes listed below. (h) The band meter is coarse (10 cells for 18 steps) and the pane strip is exact (one cell per step); the `7/18` beside each keeps them honest.
implementationNotes:
- GLYPH/TONE: doing `◉`, done `●`, todo `○`, blocked `!`, skipped `–`; add a `scheme` atom set from the `theme` row of `$.config.list()` at activation and on `config.set` {key: 'theme'}, and `lineColor(phaseIndex)` cycling [A hex pair, B hex pair, 'claude'] by that scheme (theme keys planMode/merged/claude when the row is missing); use it for done/doing stations, the rail, the badge, chips and the band's step id; todo phases stay dim. Keep success/warning/error where they are.
- `meter(done, total, cells)` returns `{ filled, train, empty }` with the train at floor(done·(cells−1)/total): the band uses 10 cells in the current line's color + dim and draws the train in success at done === total; the pane header asks for one cell per step while total ≤ 24 and returns per-phase segments so each cell takes its phase's line color, the current step's cell `◉`, and on a finished run the last cell `◉` in success. Empty: `0/0` and no strip.
- `stepRow`: prefix `├` (or `└` on the last drawn row of the phase) toned by position vs. the train, Box backgroundColor bg2 on the doing row (Text inverse on the ◉ when no scheme is known), and a right column also for todo rows with a running agent (`sonnet 1m`) and for a step a decision blocks (`? D1` in warning); needs rows get the same right column (`blocks B4`, drift age) instead of the inline age. The fold rows become `├ ● N done above` and `└ ○ +N more` so the rail stays continuous.
- `planBlock`/`fullPlan`: phase header = Text inverse badge ` B ` in the line color plus two spaces and the bold title, count in success when the phase is done; chips become `●A  ◉B  ○C` colored by line; in the Plan tab the badge row is the fold Button; an empty phase draws `○ no stations yet` dim.
- `rule()`: a section is one blank line plus a dim bold label on both mono and proportional surfaces; the chip tail stays right-aligned via flexGrow. SIGNALS: the git column wraps to its own row below 62 columns. Footer: Box gap 3 (from 2), active tab accent bold without brackets, others dim, Needs-you in warning while something waits. Band drop order unchanged, separators stay inside their segment's tone; the step Button holds a Text chip for the id.
- Animation: a Raster strip in the pane header (terminal only) repainted via `$.ui.blit` with the per-scheme hex set and 0x01000000 backgrounds; the hooks module ticks it with `$.clock.every(2000)` only while an agent runs and no key was pressed in the last 5 s (`prompt.edit`), and runs the 4-blit departure pulse from the `step` tool result; the Text strip is the frame when the Raster is not mounted; desktop Svg with a CSS pulse, mobile static.
